\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-44},
  title = {The traceability gate is enforced per milestone},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-45} (2026-09-30): a marker counts as verification only where the specification names a test as the evidence.},
  date = {2026-09-30},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Testing Strategy, CI/CD},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {The requirement-to-test matrix of NFR-07 is gated per milestone.
\texttt{tools/\allowbreak{}expected\_\allowbreak{}coverage.\allowbreak{}yaml}, a schema-validated file, states from which milestone on each requirement owes evidence.
A \texttt{req} marker counts as ``verified by a test'' only on a requirement the specification tags as automated; on a manual one it is ``named by a test''.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item A \texttt{Due} column in the specification's tables: nothing can validate a table cell.
\item No completeness gate: leaves NFR-07 to a review nobody is reminded to do.
\item Completeness over the whole table from the start: red until M6, because most functional requirements need the API.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} A gate is useful only if someone can act on it, and trustworthy only if something enforces it.
The generator refuses a malformed coverage file, and a requirement added to the documents fails the build until someone books when its evidence is due.
The two statuses keep the matrix from reporting a requirement as verified by a test that does not verify it.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted with modifications},
  assessment = {AI laid out the options and implemented the file-based gate.
An adversarial AI review then showed, by running the generator, three ways to drop a requirement from the gate, and a marker that counted as verification on a test asserting only that two files exist.
The validated milestone order and the statuses come from that review.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-30 on issue \#40 and on the review of PR \#51.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/40}{Issue \#40}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/51}{PR \#51}, \texttt{tools/\allowbreak{}expected\_\allowbreak{}coverage.\allowbreak{}yaml}, \texttt{tools/\allowbreak{}requirement\_\allowbreak{}matrix.\allowbreak{}py}.},
}
